scope: Operational wrapper only; scientific fix separately reviewed by parent

known_limitations.description: Unexpected supervisor exception or termination before child completion can lose original wait handles; running supervisor has no exception-drain finally.
Dispatch occurs before poll; an unobserved peer failure during previous sleep can be noticed only after filling newly free slot.

action: Keep the original live supervisor and its wait handles alive. Do not restart or present on-disk edits as a live fix. Monitor input stability, disk space, process liveness and errors; record all actually observed completion codes. Parent informed.
